**agenttrust — Blocked (structural).** Across 6 configurations and 4440 replay attempts: every run executed exactly once and no replay obtained the resource. The mechanism is the atomic claim store keyed by (chainId, escrow, jobId), asserted by API-005's tests as well as measured here.
